verifications.claim: All Target stores in the United States will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'No, Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year.' (Easter April 5, 2026); R2: 'All Target Stores Are Closing on April 5... Target will close all of its United States store for the full day on Easter Sunday'; R3: 'Target will be closed on Easter Sunday'; R5: 'No, all Target stores will be closed on Easter 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm all US Target stores closed on specified date.

verifications.claim: Target closes for the full day to allow employees to spend time with family on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Target encourages employees to spend time with family... Allowing Employees to Enjoy the Holiday... giving their workers some time off to spend with their family'; R3: 'allowing staff the opportunity to observe the holiday.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state closure for full day to allow employee family/holiday time.

verifications.claim: Shoppers can use Target.com and the Target app for online orders on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Guests can still shop 24/7 on Target.com and the Target app... for pickup or delivery after the Easter holiday'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states online shopping via website and app available 24/7 on the day.

verifications.claim: Costco, Sam's Club, and ALDI are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
